market_view: Rates are the main pressure (10-year 5.255% at a 52-week high, bonds' worst month in years), but August core PCE at 3.0% came in much lighter than expected, which may cap yields. VIX 16 is calm; oil is easing on recovering Middle East exports.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold 4180, near multi-month lows; 10-year at a 52-week high and dollar firm. Lighter PCE helps at the margin but is not a Fed pause; NEM free-cash-flow stories are not new information. Jobs report ahead adds variance only.

chips.reasoning: Renew the NVDA hold for 10 days: AI-demand confirmation from Micron, NVDA 3.6% below high, no guidance cut or export rule. Risks: yields at 5.255% (only slightly above 5.2%), DeepSeek-Huawei substitution headline. Lighter PCE may relieve rates.

pharma.reasoning: Two positive GLP-1 readouts released after the 09-29 close; CV safety de-risks the oral franchise. Low confidence: one noisy headline shows LLY down 2.33% (possible sell-the-news on the combo), and the Medicare MFN price model is a headwind.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper -3.2% over 5 days; no headline confirms the BHP Chile halt lasting weeks. Sunsirs 'supply pressures' piece is generic. US-Korea nuclear framework helps CCJ, not the leader FCX. Flat.

would_change_my_mind: A 10-year yield move well above 5.3% or an AI capex cut would end the NVDA long; a clear negative market reaction to Lilly's combo data would end the LLY long.
